rule: Tests use synthetic isolated/Preview data and exact role contexts. Production mutation is never a qualification method.

tests.scenario: anon direct read/write and function execution
tests.expected: all AFEX business access denied

tests.scenario: authenticated cross-tenant read on every retained/excluded table
tests.expected: zero rows or denied; no information disclosure

tests.scenario: authenticated cross-branch catalog/inventory read
tests.expected: denied outside active branch set

tests.scenario: direct authenticated customer/order/invoice/status write
tests.expected: denied before mutation

tests.scenario: policy expression inventory
tests.expected: no broad-role OR scoped-predicate composition; exact USING/CHECK

tests.scenario: profile self update attempts authority-field reassignment
tests.expected: denied; tenant/role/branch immutable

tests.scenario: PUBLIC/anon/authenticated query profiles or any profile view using full-row and forbidden-column selections
tests.expected: object access denied; RLS is not credited as column protection
tests.evidence: raw/effective ACL and Data API negative matrix

tests.scenario: verified user loads shared trusted presentation context and repeats it from multiple pages
tests.expected: route database lookup uses the exact server-only gateway rather than the user-bound authenticated client; response contains exactly username, full_name, contact_email, phone, tenant_name, branch_name and allowlisted ui_capabilities; raw profile id, tenant_id, branch_id, role, is_active, assignments, credential/security/generation/internal fields absent; one reused server authority lookup
tests.evidence: database-caller identity, response-key assertion, forbidden-key assertion, call-count trace and route authorization replay

tests.scenario: browser alters ui_capabilities or presentation fields and invokes protected route or profile self-write
tests.expected: protected route independently re-resolves trusted full authority; mutation denied; zero authority change
tests.evidence: tampered-response/request matrix and before/after authority hash

tests.scenario: PUBLIC/anon/authenticated invoke every sensitive signature and overload
tests.expected: only exact customer lookup RPC reachable by authenticated

tests.scenario: hostile tenant/branch/employee/device fields in customer/Core/PIN/inventory/cancel bodies
tests.expected: trusted context wins or request rejected

tests.scenario: search-path shadow and unqualified object attempt
tests.expected: no resolution to mutable object
tests.evidence: catalog config and isolated hostile schema

tests.scenario: all supported Saudi phone forms and duplicate concurrent create
tests.expected: one tenant identity; cross-tenant isolation; bounded projection

tests.scenario: two concurrent device activations for one branch
tests.expected: exactly one active; other deterministic conflict

tests.scenario: reused challenge, wrong key, wrong branch, replaced/lost device
tests.expected: fail closed before package/sync/acquisition

tests.scenario: all pre-enrolled employees unlock after restart/reboot without network
tests.expected: valid packages work; no time-age denial

tests.scenario: five employee failures, ten device failures, state restart/rollback
tests.expected: exact locks/delays; corrupt/rolled-back state locks

tests.scenario: employee switch with pending commands
tests.expected: keys destroyed; commands remain original actor; incoming failure stays locked

tests.scenario: credential, PIN, permission, employee revocation, device and package generation mismatch
tests.expected: acquisition denied/reviewed; no rebinding

tests.scenario: long Offline duration, wall-clock forward/backward and old sync age
tests.expected: authority not expired solely by time; age remains visible

tests.scenario: wrong account/tenant/branch/device/employee/AAD, bad signature/GCM, package rollback
tests.expected: zero plaintext and locked state

tests.scenario: logout-retain, exact purge, storage loss and key loss
tests.expected: retain permits valid Offline PIN; purge exact residue; loss requires re-enrollment

tests.scenario: first valid Offline order.create
tests.expected: one command/payload/context/binding with both actors and all generations

tests.scenario: same identity/same fingerprint repeated concurrently
tests.expected: one executor/effect and identical receipt

tests.scenario: same identity/different fingerprint
tests.expected: stable conflict; original payload/actor unchanged

tests.scenario: same command presented by different device/current employee
tests.expected: denied/reviewed; no actor substitution

tests.scenario: timeout or ambiguous response
tests.expected: unknown; bounded receipt lookup before retry; no legacy fallback

tests.scenario: positive and negative contract for all eight methods
tests.expected: original method preserved; employee_attested only; secrets rejected

tests.scenario: browser claims provider confirmation or replay attempts provider call
tests.expected: claim rejected; provider/network invocation count zero

tests.scenario: zero availability and positive insufficiency
tests.expected: exact distinct Arabic messages; no quantity increase

tests.scenario: restart commitments and snapshot inclusion frontier
tests.expected: no double deduction; pending after frontier retained

tests.scenario: concurrent server sales and ordered item locks
tests.expected: no negative stock/deadlock; conflict enters review

tests.scenario: paid stock conflict, stale price/VAT, revoked employee/device, duplicate customer, malformed command
tests.expected: immutable case linked to original command; allowed resolutions only

tests.scenario: two operators resolve same review version
tests.expected: one resolution; stale actor denied

tests.scenario: business replay and two workers claim WhatsApp/notification/print intent
tests.expected: one semantic intent and one active claim

tests.scenario: ambiguous provider result and claim timeout
tests.expected: lookup/idempotency path before retry; no business re-execution

tests.scenario: local never-acquired cancel versus unknown/acquired cancel
tests.expected: only proven never-acquired releases locally; acquired uses server command

tests.scenario: duplicate/concurrent cancel, stock restore and payment/refund state
tests.expected: one restoration and receipt; refund review when required

tests.scenario: representative cardinality and backlog at declared budgets
tests.expected: all budgets met, indexed plans, no N+1 or auth removal

tests.scenario: kill switch during pending/syncing/review/effect states
tests.expected: new work stops; immutable evidence retained; no legacy fallback

tests.scenario: post-change role/ACL/RLS/function/view/trigger/constraint/index capture
tests.expected: exact target identities and zero unexpected reachability

tests.scenario: PUBLIC/anon/authenticated query inventory_movements or inventory_movements_view directly, including columns not returned by the route
tests.expected: both relation paths denied; no row or column disclosure; security-invoker view grant alone is never treated as sufficient
tests.evidence: base/view ACL reachability and Data API negative matrix

tests.scenario: verified admin route requests same tenant, another tenant, assigned and unauthorized branches, page sizes 1/50/51, windows 1/366/367 days, and tied timestamps
tests.expected: trusted tenant always applied; only authorized branch rows; 51 and 367 rejected; exact 14-column projection; stable created_at DESC,id DESC ordering
tests.evidence: route response-key assertions, tenant/branch pair matrix, parameter bounds, query plan and deterministic pagination

tests.scenario: Wave 1 caller inventory contains one profile or inventory caller without a deployed compatible trusted replacement
tests.expected: Wave 1 stops before any ACL revocation; no broad privilege is restored as rollback
tests.evidence: caller-to-replacement matrix, deployment compatibility proof and unchanged pre-wave catalog hash

pilotRestriction: Only order.create on one separately approved branch/device after every gate; no Production approval is granted here.
